description: A list of actions that opens as a dropdown menu on desktop and an action sheet on mobile.
overview:
`ActionMenu` renders a `DropdownMenu` on desktop and an `AlertSheet` below the `48rem` breakpoint (`useIsMobile`). Each part switches to its matching component: items become `DropdownMenuItem`s or `AlertSheetAction`s, and the label becomes a menu label or the sheet title. On mobile, the content wraps the items in a grouped card and appends a Cancel button.

Use it for a short set of actions on a single object, such as editing, sharing or deleting a record, where an iOS-style action sheet suits touch screens.
usage: Pass `render` to `ActionMenuTrigger` to use your own button, for example a `Button` with `variant="outline"`. `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange` work on both layouts, so the menu can be controlled or uncontrolled. `align`, `alignOffset`, `side` and `sideOffset` on `ActionMenuContent` position the desktop popup and are ignored on mobile.

examples.WithIcons: Places an icon before every action, including a destructive Delete item.
examples.NotDismissible: Sets `dismissible` to `false` so the mobile sheet closes only through an action or Cancel.

parts.ActionMenu: The root that renders a `DropdownMenu` on desktop and an `AlertSheet` on mobile.
parts.ActionMenuTrigger: The button that opens the menu or sheet.
parts.ActionMenuContent: The popup holding the actions; on mobile it adds a Cancel button below them.
parts.ActionMenuLabel: A non-interactive heading; a menu label on desktop and the sheet title on mobile.
parts.ActionMenuItem: An actionable entry that closes the menu when chosen.
parts.ActionMenuSeparator: A divider between groups of items, rendered on desktop only.

ActionMenu.onOpenChange: Called when the menu or sheet opens or closes.
ActionMenu.dismissible: When `true`, the mobile sheet closes on an outside press; when `false`, it uses an alert dialog that closes only through an action or Cancel.

ActionMenuTrigger.render: Replaces the default button element with your own element, such as a `Button`.

ActionMenuContent.cancelLabel: Text of the Cancel button shown below the actions on mobile.

ActionMenuItem.variant: Use `destructive` to style the item as a destructive action.
ActionMenuItem.disabled: Prevents the item from being chosen.

accessibility:
- On desktop the popup has the `menu` role and each item has the `menuitem` role.
- `ArrowDown` from the trigger opens the menu and focuses the first item; arrow keys move between items and `Enter` runs the focused one.
- `Escape` closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.
notes: Parts carry `data-slot` values `action-menu`, `action-menu-trigger`, `action-menu-content`, `action-menu-label`, `action-menu-item` and `action-menu-separator`. `ActionMenuSeparator` renders nothing on mobile; the sheet groups items in a single card instead.
